{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Phoebe |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {{Rover}}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along... |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = {{Rover}}, how did you meet Abby? Sorry, I don't mean to pry, it's just the two of you are inseparable, always looking out for each other, always trusting one another. It's wonderful, Abby must be... like family. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = I know disciples of the Order should not form "attachments" to {{Extra Effect|Echoes|Echo|A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.
There's a chance for Tacet Discords to leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.}}. But they're my dear friends, and that will never change. This must be one of the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}}'s trials, a test to see if I can fulfill my duties as an {{Extra Effect|Acolyte|Acolyte|Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.}} while holding onto such... ties. It's a good test of my resolve. It's just, every time I see them, I want to hug them tightly... No, no, no, I must resist! |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = You always seem so busy, but I hardly ever see you resting... Are you, perhaps, having trouble sleeping? If that's the case, I can help. Just a little tap with my staff and your mind will be at ease... Hmm? Where are you going? It won't hurt at all... |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Balloons soaring into the bright blue sky, people and {{Extra Effect|Echoes}} rejoicing under rainbows... When the {{Extra Effect|Laurel|Laurel|At the peak of the Carnevale, the Sentinel is said to manifest and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel."
This honor grants the bearer the privilege to commune with the Sentinel and hear Their wisdom.}} was placed upon your head, I felt so happy. This {{Extra Effect|Carnevale|Carnevale|The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, a time with never-ending masquerades, wine flowing like rivers, and music pulsing through the night.
During this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.}} has been spectacular in every way, and it will remain etched in my heart forever. |vo_02_01_title = Phoebe's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = When I was little, I loved going to Whisperwind Haven with friends. We'd lie on slopes surrounded by flowers and watch the clouds drift by. Tilly would play their accordion, and Livia and Brenno would weave all sorts of garlands that left a wonderful scent in their wake. I still go back sometimes... in secret. |vo_02_02_title = Phoebe's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me... |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Something smells so good... It must be Miss Margherita's pizza cooked to perfection by Bakie... No, no, no, this month's Pizza Day already passed. What is Pizza Day you ask? It's the only day of the month we were allowed pizza at the orphanage. Even though I don't go hungry anymore, as an {{Extra Effect|Acolyte}} I must resist gluttony.... Besides, the best pizza is one that's shared with friends. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Everything we eat comes from the good earth created by the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}. According to Them, "Our bodies are vessels for our souls." Therefore, we must sustain that vessel with things that are beneficial to it, such as those found in the sacred Viscum Berry. I still have a few left, would you like to try one? The Codex says sharing makes life sweeter... |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I hope for children to be by their parent's side. For sailors to return home after long voyages. For all to soar, free as birds. For people to come together despite their differences. For the {{Extra Effect|Lament|Lament|The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.}} to not drive people apart... Huh? What do I hope for myself? I hope... I... |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = When I was a child, I awoke on a dark shore. I walked that shore for what felt like forever until I saw a light... a few kind {{Extra Effect|Acolytes|Acolyte|Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.}} of the Order brought me to a brightly lit room. They fed me, sheltered me, and treated me well. Eventually, they became my adoptive family... Sometimes when the rain lashed out at night, Livia and Brenno would cuddle up next to me until I fell asleep. With them at my side... I never felt lonely. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Brant]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Brant.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Mother once told me a story about an adventurer braving storms in search of freedom. When I saw Brant on stage, he reminded me of that adventurer, caring for naught while the ocean thrashes around him... Sometimes, I think Mr. Brant chooses to act out a life of equal parts comedy and tragedy. |vo_04_01_mention = Brant |vo_04_02_title = About [[Roccia]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Roccia.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Miss Roccia might appear ice cold, but at heart, I know she is a gentle and caring person. Her kindheartedness brings smiles to all those around her. And then there's her friend, {{Extra Effect|Pero|Pero|A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.}}. I wonder if there's any chance Pero could also be my friend? |vo_04_02_mention = Roccia |vo_04_03_title = About [[Cartethyia]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Cartethyia.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = ...I once dreamt of a black sea, with swells growing larger and more violent. Amidst the spray, the Blessed Maiden appeared—or at least I think it was her. Something in that swaying silhouette resembled her, yet it also felt so unlike her... |vo_04_03_mention = Cartethyia |vo_04_04_title = About [[Zani]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Zani.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Not everyone in {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}} worships the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}. Certain {{Extra Effect|Acolytes}} of the Order believe a person's worth is solely measured by their piety... But Miss Zani is brave and dependable, which just might be enough to overcome existing prejudices. After all, she's such a reliable and respectable person. |vo_04_04_mention = Zani |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy Birthday! Ooh... confetti! Just like how Mama and Papa used to celebrate. Here, take this, a bluebird set with aquamarine gemstones. A little something to be by your side through winds and storms. Like this statue, may your eyes always be bright, and may luck always be with you. Your path is not one ordained by the Sentinel, but one of your own making. And no matter where you go, I will always pray for you. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy... |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hmm... Ah! Hehe... |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = I'm Phoebe, an {{Extra Effect|Acolyte}} of the {{Extra Effect|Order|Order of the Deep|The de facto ruling authority of Ragunna that manages all city matters, from municipal policies and currency to civil disputes.
The head of the Order, known as the Primus, is currently Fenrico, who claims to be the Enlightened One—the Resonator of Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator.
According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word.}}. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = I'll take care of it. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = I resolve disputes in the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}'s name. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = May the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} guide those who are lost. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = The sparkling sea knows no bounds. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness? |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Your light has shown me a world I had never seen. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = Thanks to you, my light will shine upon those in need. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Phoebe |language = en |heavy_1_tx = Purify! |heavy_2_tx = Repent! |resskill_1_tx = Descend! |resskill_2_tx = Silence! |resskill_3_tx = To the Sentinel. |resskill_4_tx = Over there! |resskill_5_tx = Answer me! |resskill_6_tx = Judgment time! |resliberation_1_tx = Crystals give me strength. |resliberation_2_tx = Bluebird, be my salvation. |intro_1_tx = {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} protect me… |outro_1_tx = I call upon the Sentinel... |outro_2_tx = Shine, holy light. |outro_3_tx = In the name of {{Extra Effect|Imperator|Imperator|The Sentinel of Rinascita. Though worshipped as the Divinity by the Order of the Deep, Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the public.}}. |hit_1_tx = Careful now! |hit_2_tx = Doesn't hurt, I'm okay. |injured_1_tx = This path is arduous... |injured_2_tx = Shielding others... is my duty! |injured_3_tx = Pain is my penitence... |fallen_1_tx = Watery depths... beckon... |fallen_2_tx = This isn't... the end... |fallen_3_tx = I see the light... farewell. |esummon_1_tx = Together we stand! |etransform_1_tx = Power of the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}. |enemynear_1_tx = Dark forces approach, be on guard. |glider_1_tx = Free as a bird. |sensor_1_tx = Rays of illumination. |chest_1_tx = Cherish the gift not given lightly. |chest_2_tx = Good fortune comes your way. |chest_3_tx = Such joyful blessings They bring. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.1}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
